findings.evidence: The timeout catch synchronously invokes provider cancellation callbacks; a blocked callback can pin reminder/process convergence after WaitAsync expires. This unchanged external 0b38 recovery helper is not caused by projection delivery; retain the temporary reproduction and route to its owner.

RejectDuplicates allocates a HashSet per arbitrary nested object despite ignoring those unknown values during typed materialization. A legal finite-depth 600061-byte body retained about 24.6 MB versus 4S=3789824; the pre-graph proof-working budget can fail before rejection. The earlier R1-P2 fixed configured-depth preallocation, not this actual-depth tracker.

With AllowReadingFromString/WriteAsString, serialization and typed state sizing accept a guarded H=10000 row but the admission scan only reads numeric tokens and assigns H=0. A body over 16384 bytes can be saved and then refused by its own owning read. Honor supported integer token semantics consistently before persistence/readback.

The first route starts the shared thirty-second finalization token, then later routes run history/owner verification with the caller token. A slow sibling consumes the independent budget before its finalization. R1-B9 corrected pending recovery only; this multi-route branch remains different and reachable.

RecordLedgerRead uses ledger?.Items.Count before GetDueAsync null-tolerant flattening and HasUnresolvedConflictAsync explicit Items-null classification. A malformed non-null shard throws from metrics and stops healthy scans; make measurement tolerate that record without weakening corruption classification.

Retained-plan comparison binds selected envelope fields and effects while the translator receives the complete StreamReadEvent. A same identity/payload with changed omitted metadata passes that comparison without retranslating; ValidatePage checks continuity/bytes, not those fields. This external 0b38 process protocol is unchanged by Story 6.4; its owner must decide and verify the complete committed-evidence binding.

Available discovery calls structural ValidateState then chunks every TenantIds entry. That validator omits the MaxTenants/MaxReceipts/MaxStateBytes enforced only by the normal writer, so corrupt oversized persisted registries cause unbounded batches. This external 0b38 discovery path is outside the projection source-guard change.

The descriptor validates protocol shape, not the presence of complete shared-family owner/writer evidence. The server SupportsRoute and owner gateway explicitly reject shared-current optimization before effects; MixedSharedRoute_UnqualifiedOwnerProofPreventsWholeCatalogCurrentOrPartialEffects tests that outcome. The approved contract permits unsupported/rebuild-required when complete owning proof/compatible fallback is unavailable; advertising a known descriptor does not authorize current or journal acceptance.

Tail admission accepts mapped and full-replay plans per route, then ApplyCanonicalReplayAsync combines all replay routes. PrepareReplayRequestAsync deterministically returns null for a mapped-only-streamed/non-mapped mixture, leaving valid required fallback work unable to converge. Preserve coordinated receipt/manifest identity and required-route publication while accommodating both actual transport protocols; do not simply split the same rebuild scope/dispatch into conflicting manifests.

The sole BatchExecutions increment is ExecuteAsync; guarded full replacement calls StageAsync/CommitStagedAsync/VerifyStagedAsync directly. Its actual coordinated replacement therefore reports J=0 despite the frozen full-replacement fixture requiring J=1. Charge staged execution and failed/retried work truthfully without counting read-only verification as another logical promotion or relaxing ceilings.

CleanupOriginalManifestAsync swallows delete errors and ignores false CAS while terminal results remain successful. Guarded read-only Current never reruns the batch; DomainProjectionGuardedReplay.ReclaimAsync deletes only its separate -2 manifest. A readmodel-batch manifest can remain after original retry work is deleted. Preserve durable owned cleanup work through uncertainty and verify eventual same-identity reclamation without new preparation/model effects.
